question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

18, 13, 14, 14, 19, 14, 17, 17, 14, 20

The mode of the data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode is simply the value that appears most frequently in the given dataset.

Given data: 18, 13, 14, 14, 19, 14, 17, 17, 14, 20

By quick observation, the number 14 is repeated the most (4 times).

**∴ The correct answer is 14 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks scored by 10 students: 18, 13, 14, 14, 19, 14, 17, 17, 14, 20

**Concept Used:**

Mode = The observation with the highest frequency in a data set

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us sort the data and list the frequencies of each unique score.

⇒ Frequency of 13 marks = 1

⇒ Frequency of 14 marks = 4

⇒ Frequency of 17 marks = 2

⇒ Frequency of 18 marks = 1

⇒ Frequency of 19 marks = 1

⇒ Frequency of 20 marks = 1

⇒ The mark 14 has the highest frequency (4).

**∴ The correct answer is 14 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

Mean is the average of a dataset, calculated as the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations.

Median

Median is the middle value of an ordered dataset. For an even number of data points, it is the average of the two central values.

Empirical Relationship

For moderately skewed distributions, the measures of central tendency are related by the formula: Mode ≈ 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Bimodal Distribution

If two distinct values in a dataset share the highest frequency, the dataset is said to have two modes and is called bimodal.
